definitions.gloss: light eater; small appetite; eating sparingly
definitions.explanation: The tendency to eat only small amounts of food. Describes someone who naturally doesn't eat much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小食|しょうしょく}だ。
{小食|しょうしょく}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{大盛|おおも}り→大盛り：08162_oomori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧きれない。
examples.english: I'm a light eater, so I can't finish a large portion.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小食|しょうしょく}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: I was a light eater as a child, but I started eating more as an adult.

notes:
{小食|しょうしょく} describes someone who naturally eats small amounts — a disposition, not deliberate dieting.

USAGE:
Functions as both a noun and a な-adjective. Common patterns:
- {小食|しょうしょく}だ: to be a light eater
- {小食|しょうしょく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person with a small appetite
- {小食|しょうしょく}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で: because I'm a light eater

WRITING:
Also written as ⟦{少食|しょうしょく}→少食：08480_shoushoku⟧ ({少|しょう} meaning "few/little"). Both spellings are used interchangeably.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大食|たいしょく}→大食：29348_taishoku⟧: big eater (formal)
- ⟦{大食|おおぐ}い→大食い：08341_oogui⟧: glutton, big eater (casual, slightly negative)
- ⟦{食|く}いしん{坊|ぼう}→食いしん坊：16180_kuishinbou⟧: glutton, foodie (affectionate/playful)
